notes: *whose* goes to the resumptive suffix on שִׁנָּיו under rule 18: no אֲשֶׁר stands in the Hebrew, so rule 22's three-morpheme fusion has no relative to rest on and the suffix alone answers for the word.
*jaw teeth* heads on *teeth* by rule 31's tie-break: the ASV writes a bare *teeth* for שֵׁן in this same verse, so the class noun carries the lexeme and *jaw* is the specifier.
Both italic *as* words belong to their predicate nominals under rule 33; the copula is written once and gapped in the second line.
